title: JSON API: employees, HR sync, audit
interface: Blueprint `bp` (name 'api_employees'; mounted at /api/v1). All routes require api_auth_required. GET /employees?q=&active= -> 200 list (search when q). GET /employees/<path:email> -> 200 | 404 {'error': 'not found'}. POST /hr/employees JSON {'employees': [...]} -> 200 sync result dict; ValueError (e.g. missing email) -> 400 {'error'}; a body without an 'employees' list -> 400. POST /hr/employees/csv with the CSV as the raw request body (request.get_data(as_text=True)) -> 200 sync result. GET /audit?limit=50 -> 200 list of audit entries. Services built per request from get_db(): HrSyncService(EmployeeRepository(db), AssetRepository(db), AuditRepository(db), assignments=AssignmentRepository(db)).
